This was one of my first toner purchases when I started getting into skincare a few months ago when COVID started (Feb 2020). After all these years of harsh products to address what I thought was my oily skin, I found out that I suffered from dehydrated skin and a damaged skin barrier, which most likely caused the oiliness and patches of dryness. I was looking for an affordable and simple toner to use for the 7-skins method to repair my skin barrier. This was recommended by a number of YouTubers and also on the Deciem Facebook group page. I have been trying a number of other essences and toners, adding them to my routine over time, and I like the clean, simple feel of this one. I use it in the morning now with a pad as my first toner and to wipe off any reside from the night before rather than using any type of cleanser. I also love that it has niacinamide and other hydrating/brightening ingredients. I was initially put off by the fragrance which smells good but I don't really like fragrance in my skin care, but to be honest, I don't smell it after I put it on and as I'm writing this after completing my first bottle (yes, it's lasted me this long and I used it in AM and PM), I actually forgot it has fragrance (perhaps because I use it with a pad now rather than a few drops on my hand to pat on my face) and probably only had whiffs of it from my hand.
Lozione tonico molto buono come tutta la linea dalla Bioderma!

avis.titre: Bioderma Toner – Gentle and Recommended, But Hard to Judge ResultsBioderma Toner – Gentle and Recommended, But Hard to J
avis.texte: This Bioderma body toner was recommended by my wife’s dermatologist, so we felt confident giving it a try. ✅ Used daily – She’s been applying it regularly as part of her skincare routine. ✅ Gentle on skin – No irritation or negative reaction, which is a big plus. ✅ Trusted brand – Bioderma always feels like a safe choice when it comes to skincare. 🤷‍♀️ That said, it’s hard to tell if it’s actually improving anything. Maybe the results are subtle or take longer to notice — but so far, there’s no visible change. A safe and gentle toner, especially when recommended by a dermatologist — just don't expect dramatic results right away.
